text: Why is the shipping container a good analogy for layering?
choices: Because standardising one interface — dimensions and corner fittings — made the contents irrelevant to every crane, lorry and ship
explanation: McLean's insight was about the interface, with a deliberate refusal to standardise anything on either side of it. Loading cost fell from about $5.86 per ton to $0.16 — not an improvement but a different industry.
